rows.note: Use 潮 as the all-purpose casual choice for something trendy or currently in fashion.

example.english: These fashionable sneakers are hard to buy these days.
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 ciu4 ge3 bo1 haai4 hou2 naan4 maai5

rows.note: Use 有型 when fashionable mainly means stylish or cool-looking, especially of a person, outfit, or object.

example.english: You look really fashionable in this suit.
example.traditional: 你着呢套西裝真係有型。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoek3 ni1 tou3 sai1 zong1 zan1 hai6 jau5 jing4

rows.note: Use 流行 when something is widely popular or current, including a style, idea, or philosophy.

example.english: Eating plant-based meat is fashionable now.
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 lau4 hang4 sik6 zik6 mat6 juk6

rows.note: Use 入時 for a generally up-to-date, in-fashion appearance rather than specifically a cool or youth-oriented style.

example.english: After getting a new hairstyle, Mum looks really fashionable.
example.traditional: 阿媽剪完個新髮型，成個人都好入時。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 zin2 jyun4 go3 san1 faat3 jing4 seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 hou2 jap6 si4
